R0230.title: Public Cloud Storage Bucket Exposure
R0230.definition: Object storage buckets or snapshots are misconfigured for public access, causing data leakage.
R0230.description:
Public cloud storage bucket exposure usually comes from object storage, backup snapshots, log buckets, or static asset buckets configured for public access. Once sensitive files are public, search engines, scanners, or attackers can download them directly.

This risk requires little technical sophistication but can cause large data breaches. Organizations need continuous public asset inventory, clear separation of static content from sensitive data, and alerting on public policies.
R0230.influence: Public buckets can directly leak customer data, logs, backups, and key files, leading to regulatory and trust impact.
